goal: Add a modular production Linode provider alongside DigitalOcean, Vultr and UpCloud. Complete driver, account preview, catalog Ubuntu support, per-account guarded proxy transport, SSH inline identities, safe create/delete/reconciliation, resources, truthful capacity and billing, dashboard and browser integration. Preserve all current controls and unrelated providers.
context: Canonical494b95a/runtime9e59e3a. Existing prior routing/lifecycle acceptance is explicitly paused by user and must not be repaired or claimed stable in this scope. Linode APIv4 authoritative docs inspected: bearerPAT; authorized_keys installs root key; instance numeric ID; list pages/results/data; delete removes local disks/backups but detaches block volumes, reserved IPs retained; never create extra volumes/reserved IPs/backups. Exact account quota is not documented; mark the numeric maximum unknown, use complete inventory for usage, classify explicit quota rejection as capacity and retain bounded shared workflow retry/backoff. Never infer an exact global count from a generic resource-limit rejection. Account/settings defaults may enable automatic backups; preserve account defaults and document price/constraints honestly. Model errors sanitize raw provider bodies. Existing InlineSSHKeys path supplies per-deployment root key. No Linode production credential has been supplied. Evidence-based bounded tests and native compatibility; no real-cloud acceptance claim without live account.
commit_message: feat(provider): integrate Linode driver and lifecycle support
